messages:
jess: Heads-up — hitting a couple of SDK parity annoyances in Node sample app while onboarding a customer. 1) SDK has no helper for listing models (/models) so sampleapp falls back to REST; 2) param name mismatch: JS client uses `temp` but REST/docs show `temperature`; 3) retry behavior: 429s ignore Retry-After header and immediately retry. Anyone seen this? :grimacing:

sam: Can you paste the minimal repro and which SDK version? We should file a bug if it's twofold.

jess: repro below. running `npm i @redwood/sdk@0.13.1`
```js
// sample.js
const r = require('@redwood/sdk')
await r.generate({ model: 'wizard-v1', temp: 0.2, prompt: 'hi' })
```
It works with REST `temperature` but SDK silently swallows `temp` for sampling, returns same logits every call.

liam: @jess thanks. We renamed `temperature` -> `temp` early on to match some clients but forgot to update docs + TypeScript defs. That's on us. For 429 retries: which HTTP client are you on? We recently swapped fetch lib in 0.13.1 and lost Retry-After logic.

jess: Node 18, fetch built-in. Sampleapp uses SDK default. Repro also shows when backend returns `Retry-After: 5` SDK still retries immediately 3x and then errors.

liam: OK. I'll open a PR: add alias handling so `temperature` accepted, and restore Retry-After delay handling in retry middleware. Quick fix: set env `REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY=false` to disable aggressive retries for onboarding customers.

sam: Can we also update quickstart guide to mention env var names? onboarding docs still reference `REDWOOD_API_KEY` while SDK looks for `REDWOOD_KEY` now.

jess: Yup, confused 2 customers today. Small doc tweak + patch release would calm them. :pray:

ci-bot: Pipeline triggered for branch fix/sdk-temp-retry — build queued.

liam: I'll target a patch 0.13.2 today. Leaving notes in the SDK issue with repro and link to this thread.

jess: Awesome, thanks!
